decisions.reason: As a design-led finish extension of the core drainage range, it draws on the firm's existing production, sales, and installer knowledge, so absorptive capacity is high and withdrawal is unlikely.
This shower channel remains very close to the firm's established technical base and customer channels, making it easy to evaluate, refine, and retain commercially.

The pump-assisted drainage line is more complex than standard products, but it still builds on the firm's drainage know-how, service capability, and in-house R&D, so continued learning favors keeping it.
A tileable floor drain with grating fits the firm's established expertise and the continuing demand for modern barrier-free bathroom solutions, so management would be inclined to keep it.
This stainless steel design grate is a close adjacent product that leverages the firm's design-engineering strengths and broad portfolio logic, leaving little reason to remove it soon.

Although the pump-drain shower channel requires more market and installation learning than standard drains, it is still related enough to the firm's knowledge base and R&D effort that continuation is more likely than exit.
